name: evolvo_book_appointment
description: Book a real appointment on a date and time the caller has just accepted from evolvo_check_availability. Two preconditions: (1) you offered this exact day and time and the caller said yes - send slot_accepted true; (2) you read the phone number back digit by digit and the caller answered yes in a later turn - send phone_confirmed true. If either has not happened, do not call yet; once both have, call straight away. Also needs a real full name (never a placeholder) and the accepted doctor or branch, date and time; the system re-checks the slot is still free. offer_slot_first: nothing booked - offer the day and time, ask if it suits, end your turn, then call again with slot_accepted true. confirm_phone_first: nothing booked - read the number in read_back back, ask if it is correct, end your turn, then call again with phone_confirmed true. success true means the appointment is made whatever booking_mode says (appointment_linked_to_existing_patient and lead_pending_staff_confirmation are internal; to the caller both are simply booked): say it is registered for that weekday, date and time, then the reminder sentence; never say a colleague will ring back about it. If the response carries replaced_appointment, this booking completed a reschedule and the earlier appointment was already handled: with cancelled true, say in one sentence the appointment has been moved from the old day and time to the new one; with cancelled false, say the new time is booked and a colleague will tidy up the earlier one. Either way never call evolvo_manage_appointment to cancel the old one. date_not_available or time_not_available: the slot went - say so in one short sentence, offer one of alternative_days / free_times_that_day, and on the yes call again at once without asking for name or phone again. ambiguous_calendar: ask the caller to pick one of the listed doctor+location pairs. ambiguous_patient: ask for the full name exactly as registered with Optofarm and call again. Say booked only when success is true.

full_name.description: The caller's full name as given and confirmed (last version if they corrected themselves). For a reschedule, the person name exactly as evolvo_find_appointments spelled it; do not ask for it again.

phone.description: Digits only as dictated, no spaces, no leading zero or country code added or removed. For a reschedule it must be the number the appointment was found on, or the old one is not cancelled.

phone_confirmed.description: true only if you read this exact number back digit by digit and the caller answered yes in a later turn; otherwise false. Never guess: a wrong true books on a wrong number.

slot_accepted.description: true only if you spoke this exact day and time to the caller and they said it suits; otherwise false. Never guess.

date.description: Accepted date, YYYY-MM-DD, exactly as returned by evolvo_check_availability.

time.description: Accepted time, HH:MM 24h, exactly as returned by evolvo_check_availability.

doctor.description: Provider of the accepted slot exactly as the availability result spelled it, prefix included. At least one of doctor or location.

location.description: Branch keyword from the availability lookup: Fortuna, Postei, Trandafirilor, Doja, Republicii, Bulevard, Reghin, Sovata.

city.description: City, only if that is all the caller gave.

problem.description: What the caller wants, one short sentence for a colleague (glasses, OCT, check-up, eye pressure, a described problem, a child). For a reschedule say so, e.g. 'reschedule of the appointment on <old date>'.

email.description: Only if the caller volunteered one; otherwise leave out.
